info.title: i揭东 API
info.description: i揭东 Demo v0 API contract (B04 query endpoints; auth/AI/admin endpoints pending).

get.description: Paginated region list filtered by level, parent, name, and enabled state.
Nested region tree starting at root_code, including up to depth edges.

parameters.name: depth

schema.description: Number of edges below the root.
schema.title: Depth

parameters.description: Number of edges below the root.

get.description: Return one region with its parent summary. 404 when the region is missing.
Return region text, applicable numeric metrics, and data freshness. Development zones omit farmland, forest, and village-count indicators; villages omit district-only indicators.
Return enabled indicator metadata ordered by sort_order.

parameters.name: level

schema.description: Only indicators applicable to this region level.
schema.title: Level

parameters.description: Only indicators applicable to this region level.

get.description: Return one indicator's metadata or 404 when it is missing.

get.summary: Rank regions by a numeric indicator
get.description: Rank published numeric values for one region level. Null values and missing/not_applicable/suppressed qualities are excluded. Text indicators return 422 INDICATOR_NOT_NUMERIC.

parameters.name: include_development_zones

schema.description: Include development zones when ranking town level.
schema.title: Include Development Zones

parameters.description: Include development zones when ranking town level.

get.summary: Compare regions by a numeric indicator
get.description: Compare 2-20 regions in the requested order. Missing values stay null; differences are only computed when both the region and first value are numeric.

parameters.name: region_codes

schema.description: Comma-separated region codes in display order.
schema.title: Region Codes

parameters.description: Comma-separated region codes in display order.

parameters.name: region_ids

schema.description: Comma-separated region IDs in display order.
schema.title: Region Ids

parameters.description: Comma-separated region IDs in display order.

get.description: Paginated observations joined with region and indicator fields. Null numeric values are preserved and never replaced with zero; an empty result set returns 200 with an empty data list.
District-level core metrics for one period. Null values stay null with a quality_status; town_count counts enabled town-level regions.

value_number.title: Value Number
value_number.description: Numeric value; null means no published value.

diff_from_first.title: Diff From First
diff_from_first.description: Value minus the first region value; null when either side is missing.

diff_pct_from_first.title: Diff Pct From First
diff_pct_from_first.description: Percentage difference from the first region; null when not computable.

CompareItemOut.title: CompareItemOut
CompareItemOut.description: One region inside a comparison result, in the requested order.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display label taken from indicator metadata.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Measurement unit taken from indicator metadata.

value_number.title: Value Number
value_number.description: Numeric value; null means no published value (never zero-filled).

data_as_of.title: Data As Of
data_as_of.description: Latest data update or successful import time.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Core district metrics in a stable display order.

DashboardOverviewOut.title: DashboardOverviewOut
DashboardOverviewOut.description: District-level overview for one data period.

value_number.title: Value Number
value_number.description: Numeric value; null means no data and is never replaced with zero.

quality_status.title: Quality Status

status.title: Status
status.description: Publication status: draft, published, or archived.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Last update time of the observation.

DataValueOut.title: DataValueOut
DataValueOut.description: One observation joined with its region and indicator display fields.

unit.title: Unit

direction.title: Direction

period_year.title: Period Year
